attributes.title: 2027 MMHCA Annual Conference
attributes.series: Missouri Mental Health Counselors Association Annual Conference
attributes.cme_provider: Missouri Mental Health Counselors Association (ACEP No. 2059)
attributes.summary:
The Missouri Mental Health Counselors Association holds its 2027 Annual Conference from October 21 to 23, 2027, at Old Kinderhook Resort in Camdenton, at the Lake of the Ozarks. A separate Brainspotting conference is listed at the same venue on October 21.

MMHCA is an NBCC Approved Continuing Education Provider (ACEP No. 2059). Registration includes clock hours for the sessions attended; the total number of hours, the program and the fees were not published yet when we checked.
